admission.justification: Publication that changes the message, index shape or hook behavior would make the committed object differ from the reviewed one.

applicability: Publication message, index and hook behavior on the shared primitive.
conditions: Configured caller-message cleanup and index flags remain faithful; a product hook policy cannot bypass pre-commit. Required Commit-Check-Pass metadata is separate from the cleaned caller body.
exclusions: Prepared routes are separate ordinary git commit routes without a no-verify bypass; commit-tree itself omits other native commit hooks but explicit repository pre-commit precedes publication.
statement: Publication preserves the ruled message, index flags and hook behavior and names real ref/lock failures.
